name: Na photoionization-rate and survival-kernel verification
purpose: Verify the compiled Na lifetime and the LSO lunar-shadow enabled/disabled return contract.
configuration: Na-only; constant legacy lifetime; orbit-on additionally uses the frozen SPICE state for Earth-shadow geometry.
inputs: Na at +2 lunar radii on the LSO sunward axis
Na at -2 lunar radii in the cylindrical lunar shadow
independent_reference: Direct 3600*5.8/0.4^2 seconds evaluation and the declared LSO +X-to-Sun cylindrical-shadow geometry.
frame_time_convention: Moon-centred LSO with +X toward the Sun; the orbit-on state uses the frozen M0 UTC/SPICE contract.
deterministic_stochastic_controls: No random reaction draw; kernel lifetime only.
procedure: Call the compiled lifetime function at sunward and anti-sunward axial fixtures; compare the lifetime and illumination flags.
acceptance_criteria: Sunlit lifetime within 1e-14 relative and allowed; in orbit-on mode the anti-sunward axial fixture returns -1 s and disallows reaction.
expected_pass_result: The compiled Na baseline lifetime equals 130500 s in sunlight and the near-lunar nightside is gated in orbit-on mode.
required_data: frozen M0 SPICE kernels for the orbit-on branch
data_hashes: U04 owns the exact M0 kernel hashes; D04 is required before an authoritative rate claim
status_semantics: PASS verifies the legacy local kernel only; it is not PHIDRATES validation or linked Na-to-Na+ conversion.
